summary: Per-frame session lifecycle/scoring update. Reads the session phase ID; when nonzero, adds the frame time delta to the session elapsed accumulator, then runs a network-comm-gated block (player slot sync, collision timestep/iteration, grid/track-opening timers, server OK request and track-open signal), or on the comm-not-ready path decrements a countdown timer that triggers a global state transition when exhausted. Always advances a secondary elapsed accumulator and drains a pending session-state dispatch linked list, then conditionally dispatches a string payload and hands the object to the mouse input handler.

operations.description: obj = *this; v3 = obj[0x3FC4] (session phase/state id), dereferencing the session object base pointer.
If session phase/state id == 0, return immediately (no session active).
If state id is neither 1 nor 2, set v16 = 0 and add v17 to obj+0x388 elapsed accumulator.
If state id is 1 or 2, set v16 = 1; call StructFieldReadAt0x3e14(this) and if it returns > 1, add v17 to obj+0x388 accumulator instead.
Test network-comm readiness by calling SingleDelegationCall_a900 with obj[0x3FB8] as the argument.

Comm-ready path: ClearPlayerSlots(this, 0), NetCommPlayerSlotSync(this), ClientGridDisplayTimer, CollisionContactBufferTimestepUpdate(this+26864, v17), CollisionContactIteration, TrackOpeningProgressTimer.
If obj+0x28 (ServerOK-requested flag) is nonzero: send SendServerOKRequest, clear obj+0x28, and if v16 is set and obj+0x29 is clear, send ServerOpenTrackSignal.
Comm-not-ready path: subtract v17 from obj+0x37C countdown timer; when it drops below 0.0 call GlobalStateSetter(1), sub_4A0DB0(&unk_7CE24D) and sub_4A0490(&unk_7CE24C).
Always add v17 to obj+0x384 secondary elapsed-time accumulator.
v5 = obj[0x1B770]; if nonzero, load the linked-list head node at *(v5), clear byte v5+8, and call LinkedListNodeRemoval on it; if it returns false, treat the head as empty.

Drain the session-state dispatch linked list: for each node, v6 = node data or fall back to byte_5EA438 when the data pointer is null, call SessionStateDispatch(v6), then free node data and node via FreeWrapper_7bcf; re-walk obj[0x1B770] to find and unlink the next pending node; repeat until no pending node remains.
If v16 is set (state was 1 or 2 and struct field <= 1), call StringLengthCheckDispatch on a string buffer at obj+112528.
Pass the session object to MouseInputHandler at the end of the frame update.
